notes: The catalogue lists 'Darmarāja' (probably Dharmarāja) as scribe, but the quoted colophon names no scribe or other person. The name probably comes from a part of the manuscript the cataloguer did not quote, such as the Śāntikādhyāya section or a marginal note, so it is left out here. The repeated 'rāmaḥ' is an invocation, not a personal name. The colophon has no date or place.
